project_summary: Old Dominion University (ODU) is seeking proposals for an AI-driven enterprise website search and personalization solution. The project aims to establish a unified search experience across ODU's main and ODUGlobal web properties, enhancing content discovery, relevance, and tailored digital experiences for diverse audiences. The solution must also provide robust analytics, accessibility features, and integrate with the university's Drupal-based ecosystem.

IV. 
STATEMENT OF NEEDS: 
The selected Contractor shall provide a comprehensive AI-driven site search and personalization 
solution for odu.edu and ODUGlobal web properties. At a minimum, the proposal should address the 
following needs: 
 
Uniﬁed Search Experience: Provide a search platform capable of indexing and managing content 
across multiple University web properties, domains, and subdomains through a uniﬁed 
administration model while still allowing site-speciﬁc controls, proﬁles, or result experiences where 
appropriate. 
 
AI-Enhanced Search: Provide advanced search capabilities such as semantic relevance, natural-
language query handling, smart answers or answer-ﬁrst experiences, query assistance, synonym 
management, and other AI-supported tools that improve the accuracy and usefulness of results. 
 
Personalization and Audience Relevance: Describe how the solution can support personalized or 
audience-aware experiences based on user intent, content type, location, behavior, or other 
conﬁgurable signals, while allowing the University to maintain governance and editorial control. 
 
Search Administration and Governance: Include tools for promoting results, tuning rankings, 
managing synonyms, curating featured results, handling no-results queries, and applying business 
rules that reﬂect University terminology and priorities. 
 
Analytics and Reporting: Provide analytics dashboards and reporting for search usage, top queries, 
click-through behavior, low-performing queries, zero-result searches, content gaps, engagement, 
and other metrics needed to guide ongoing optimization and leadership reporting. 
 
Accessibility and Content Quality: Describe capabilities that support accessibility standards, 
including WCAG 2.1 AA and Section 508, and help identify content issues that may affect ﬁndability, 
usability, or AI-readiness, including content auditing and recommendations where available. 
 
Implementation, Training, and Support: Provide implementation services, conﬁguration, testing, 
launch support, administrator training, end-user documentation, and ongoing customer success and 
technical support. Contractors should describe the proposed implementation timeline, required 
University resources, and post-launch support model. 
 
Integration and Technical Fit: Describe compatibility with Drupal and related web technologies, 
available APIs and modules, security and authentication considerations, indexing methods, and the 
approach for integrating with the University's existing digital environment. 
 
Scalability and Future Readiness: Demonstrate how the solution can scale across additional sites,

assisted discovery, personalization, and cross-site search governance. 
 
Pricing Structure: Provide a clear pricing model that identiﬁes one-time implementation costs,

optional modules or services.
